original_eight_reviewed_files_validation: pass; no frozen trainer/protocol/config/test changes required
scope: Independent review of new read-only progress observer. Does not approve or claim a writer atomic-replace fix.

findings.description: Sharing comment changed from assertion of atomic-replace safety to best-effort only; observer avoids live status.json and training-summary.json.
Absent protocol now reports initializing with unknown total/ETA instead of computing from null fields.

PowerShell 7 ConvertFrom-Json converts ISO strings to DateTime. String roundtrip lost UTC Kind and produced an eight-hour PID-time mismatch. Reader now preserves DateTime via DateTimeOffset cast and parses only string values.

tests.execution: CPU-only synthetic filesystem fixtures in ignored .local; no live status/summary, GPU, API or model inference
checks: Missing protocol returns initializing with null ETA
Complete newline-terminated JSONL rows read; incomplete final append ignored
Observer succeeds while synthetic status and training-summary files are exclusively locked
Example ETA 152.9 minutes matches 3058 remaining steps times 3 seconds
Both UTC Z and +08 timestamps recognize the fixture process correctly
PID with mismatching creation timestamp marked not alive
Malformed earlier complete JSONL row raises rather than being silently ignored

limitations: WinError 5 root cause is not proven. FileShare.ReadWrite|Delete alone previously did not demonstrate safe replacement; this observer avoids reading the files training atomically replaces.
The frozen writer still has no retry. Future environmental file interference can still stop training.
Launcher existence and creation-time match are not proof that the actual worker makes progress; compare step observations and inspect process/error information when stopped.

JSONL is append-only during normal training but may be truncated back to the saved checkpoint during recovery. A snapshot during that transition is provisional and is not committed checkpoint evidence.
ETA excludes load/evaluation/saving and may include observations from before the current launch; log_precedes_current_launch helps identify that case.
Tests do not claim end-to-end uninterrupted GPU training or numerical resume equivalence.
